## Description

Use this key to provide URLs to service level agreement (SLA) documentation for a vendor service.

The value is a JSON document.

This key is useful for compliance tracking, customer-facing documentation, and operational
awareness of service guarantees.

:::note[Validation Constraint]

The value **must** be a valid JSON array or object. If the value is an array,
each element **must** be a valid URL string. The array **must** contain at least one element.

If the value is an object, each key **must** be a valid Kubernetes label value
(alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots). Each value **must** be a valid URL string. The object **must** also contain at least one key-value pair.

You can define validation rules that enforce this validation. Because vendors
are free to define their own keys, your validation should not narrow from the
overall value schema.

:::
